title: Billing / POS
subtitle: Finish a customer selection with a simulated sale. Only completion changes stock.
empty: Retrieve selected garments in Sessions & picking, then create a draft bill.
paymentNote: Labels only. No money is collected or verified.
confirmBody: The saved draft quantities will be deducted from their exact source boxes. A fictional invoice and stock movements will be recorded.
abandonBody: No stock will change. Retrieved items stay in the customer session so you can bill them later or return them to their original boxes.
dirty: Save changes before completing. Leaving this screen discards unsaved edits; the last saved draft remains.
validation: Check quantities, discount and tax values. Quantities must be whole numbers of at least 1.
remaining: Buying fewer than retrieved? Remaining units stay in the session for billing or return-to-box.
savedEmpty: Your next completed sale will appear in Sales & insights.
lineDiscount: Line discount (₹, total for this line)
removeLineNote: This item stays Retrieved in its session. Reject it there and return it to its original box. Removing the last item abandons the draft; stock does not change.
offersApplied: Active offers reviewed and saved. Higher existing line discounts were preserved. Check the total before completing the sale.
offersError: Could not read valid offer data. Existing bill prices were not changed.
offersNote: Save edits first, then apply current offers against the draft’s saved unit prices. The best active offer applies per unit; higher existing line discounts remain. Bill-level discounts remain separately (capped to the new subtotal). Saved discounts stay fixed even after an offer expires—review the final total.

pos.title: Operations workspace
pos.subtitle: Manage the fictional catalogue and physical stock. Changes stay in this browser.
pos.adminOnly: Switch to Admin preview to edit catalogue data. Display modes are not authentication.
pos.name: Name
pos.matrixNote: New colour × size combinations start with zero stock. Existing SKU identities and variants are retained. Archive individual variants below; removing a colour from this form does not delete its history.
pos.archiveNote: The record and its stock remain in history. Active picks must be resolved before archiving.
pos.locationNote: Boxes with stock or active picks cannot be renamed, moved or disabled. Rack and shelf names group boxes; edit empty boxes individually.
pos.stockNote: Counts replace on-hand and non-sellable quantities. Transfers preserve total stock. Damage keeps physical units on hand but removes them from sellable stock.
pos.stockConfirmBody: This updates the selected SKU and records a movement. Check the source, quantity and reason before continuing.
pos.imagePolicy: JPEG, PNG or WebP only. Uploads are resized to 1000 px and compressed to JPEG; up to 12 images and 2.5 MB of encoded image data per demo. Images persist in this browser and are included in saved data. Reset removes uploads.
pos.label: Image description
pos.imageRemoveBody: This removes this browser’s saved copy of the image.
pos.returnBody: Returned units will enter the chosen box. Refunds use the original paid amount, including allocated discounts and tax. No real payment is sent.
pos.replacementNote: A return is refunded in full first. A linked replacement is a separate sale at its current price. No hidden netting or real money transfer.
pos.posNote: Confirm the units are physically retrieved from this box. This creates a saved bill; stock decreases only when the bill is completed.
pos.vocabNote: Renames update all designs, including archived records. Used values cannot be removed.
pos.invalidImage: Image could not be processed. Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP under 10 MB.
pos.unsavedHint: Unsaved design edits. Save before leaving.
pos.intakeNote: Nothing changes until confirmation. Existing quantities are added as restock; new SKUs receive opening stock. Photos are optional. All records are fictional demo data.
pos.invalidMatrix: Enter whole quantities from 0 to 100000 and an active destination for each nonzero row.
pos.matrixInstructions: Enter units to receive for each colour and size. Zero skips stock. Split a SKU across more boxes using Add box row.
pos.reviewTotals: {variants} colour/size combinations · {units} units to receive · {photos} photos
pos.fourPhotos: Choose up to four photos per batch.
pos.photoDrop: Drop photos here or browse — up to 4 images, JPEG / PNG / WebP, 10 MB each.
pos.saveBeforeAdd: Save your bill edits before adding more items.
pos.chooseSkuSource: Enter an exact SKU to see available boxes
pos.emptyBox: This box is empty. Its location is retained for future stock.

upgrade1: Customer records are invalid. Restore a complete backup before checkout.
upgrade3: Save bill edits first, then choose the customer and reward. Receipt links automatically at checkout. Earn 1 point per INR 100 net paid; redeem 1 point for INR 1 before tax. Points are deducted only after sale completion. Refunded sales reduce earned points; spent rewards are not automatically returned.
